headers.Subject: Interview invitation: Senior Backend Engineer at Acme

snippet: Would Tuesday 15 September at 3:00 PM EET work for a 45-minute interview?
body_text: Hi, I'm Jordan, the hiring manager for Senior Backend Engineer (Req 12345). We'd love to schedule a 45-minute technical interview. Would Tuesday 15 September 2026 at 3:00 PM Africa/Cairo time work? The call will be on Google Meet. Reply to confirm.
